files.patch:
@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ jobs:
       - name: v2 emit gate (v2 ≡ v1, byte-identical)
         run: npm run test:trussbars-v2
 
-      # The VM backend (`truss-vm`): the lenient tree-walk renders the corpus and
-      # must byte-match the interpreter on every covered case.
-      - name: VM gate (tree-walk ≡ interpreter)
-        run: npm run test:trussbars-vm
+      # The interpreter backend (`truss-interp`): the lenient tree-walk renders the corpus
+      # and must byte-match the oracle on every covered case.
+      - name: Interpreter gate (tree-walk ≡ oracle)
+        run: npm run test:trussbars-interp

@@ -77,7 +77,7 @@
     "test:compile": "spago build && node packages/compile/conformance.mjs",
     "test:trussbars-conformance": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs",
     "test:trussbars-v2": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --v2",
-    "test:trussbars-vm": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --vm",
+    "test:trussbars-interp": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --interp",
     "gen:trussbars-snapshots": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --update",
     "test:minbars-spec": "spago build && node packages/minbars/test/spec-conformance.mjs",
     "gen:editors-manifests": "node editors/scripts/sync-manifests.mjs",
